verdict.rationale: Filee's own docs (llms.txt) list conversions by format family in input→output form, for example DWG/DXF to PDF, SVG and PNG; subtitles, fonts, 3D and data formats "into each other"; and ebooks to PDF, EPUB, Word. A power user can check many pairs this way, but the lists are prose, some end in open-ended "and more", and automatically found multi-step routes (HWP → HWPX → DOCX) are not listed as pairs. missing for 10: a complete, explicit input×output conversion matrix, no open-ended "and more" lists, documentation of which multi-step routes exist, independent corroboration that the listed pairs work.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it

citations.quote: AutoCAD DWG and DXF: convert between them or to PDF, SVG and PNG, without AutoCAD.
SRT, ASS, WebVTT, SAMI (SMI), LRC, TTML and MicroDVD into each other without any engine, saved as UTF-8
Desktop and web fonts: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT into each other.
JSON, JSON Lines, YAML, TOML and XML into each other, and tables to and from CSV and Excel.
EPUB, Kindle (MOBI, AZW, AZW3), FictionBook and comic archives (CBZ, CBR, CB7…) to PDF, EPUB, Word and more, and KEPUB for Kobo readers.
Turn PDFs into images, editable Word or HWPX documents, PowerPoint slides, text or a comic archive
